description: Crawl a site starting from a URL (same-origin pages only, bounded by maxPages) and check every linked URL for broken status codes. Returns broken links with the page(s) they were found on. Note: some external sites (e.g. social platforms) block automated HEAD/GET requests and may show up as false positives.

checkExternal.description: Also check links pointing off-site (default true; crawling never follows off-site links)

maxPages.description: Max same-origin pages to crawl (default 20, capped at 50)

name: broken_link_check
